name: PubMed
description: A citation network of PubMed scientific publications, commonly used for semi-supervised node classification; nodes represent publications and edges represent citation relationships, with labels for research topics.
citation: Sen, P., Namata, G., Bilgic, M., Getoor, L., Galligher, B., & Eliassi-Rad, T. (2008). Collective Classification in Network Data. AI Magazine, 29(3), 93–106. https://doi.org/10.1609/aimag.v29i3.2157
